name: shipwright
description: Production-grade Claude Code skills for shipping quality code via audit → review → docs → PR pipeline.

plugins.name: shipwright
plugins.description: Full shipping pipeline: 12 skills + a read-only Opus code-reviewer agent. Audit and review run as one parallel batch, the same reviewer re-checks every fix round (faster, no oscillating scores). Strict gates: code >9/10, UX 10/10, docs binary pass/fail.
